note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article on the Olifant. The values are the family figures the article publishes, with the mark in the state text. Every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. The article publishes no maker and no range.

operating_weight_kg.state: weight published as 57 long tons (58 t); the tonne taken as 1,000 kg

length_mm.locator: Infobox, length row, with gun forward entry
length_mm.state: length published as 32 ft 3 in with the gun forward; the same row publishes 24 ft 9.5 in for the hull, and 1 ft = 304.8 mm and 1 in = 25.4 mm

width_mm.locator: Infobox, width row, with side plates entry
width_mm.state: width published as 11 ft 1 in with side plates; the same row publishes 10 ft 9 in without side plates, and 1 ft = 304.8 mm and 1 in = 25.4 mm

height_mm.state: height published as 9 ft 7.75 in, and 1 ft = 304.8 mm and 1 in = 25.4 mm

ground_clearance_mm.state: ground clearance published as 1 ft 8 in, and 1 ft = 304.8 mm and 1 in = 25.4 mm

engine_model.value: Continental AV1790 V-12 air-cooled turbo diesel
engine_model.state: engine published as a Continental AV1790 V-12 air-cooled turbo diesel for the marks after the Mk.1, as published

published_power_hp.locator: Infobox, engine power row, Mk.2 entry
published_power_hp.state: engine power published as up to 1,040 hp (775 kW) for the Mk.2, with no net basis

transmission_type.state: transmission published as an automatic gearbox for the Mk.1A, Mk.1B and Mk.2

max_speed_kmh.state: road speed published as 35 mph for the Mk.1A, Mk.1B and Mk.2; converted at 1 mile = 1.609344 km
